The plate is square and about 26 cm across in the image, which makes it a dinner plate. It holds braised beef pieces with a leaf, plus cauliflower florets.

Beef: roughly 3 pieces, about 90 g total, braised. At around 200 kcal per 100 g, that is about 180 kcal.

Cauliflower: about 100 g at 25 kcal per 100 g, so about 30 kcal. It looks as though it may have some butter, which could add a little more, so I'll allow about 45 kcal.

The leaf and any sauce add roughly 10 g and 10 kcal.

Total is about 200 g of food and about 235 kcal.
